subject: physics
formal_statement: An object remains at rest or in uniform motion in a straight line unless acted upon by a net external force.

common_misconceptions.description: believes objects can start moving with no force applied
believes constant motion still requires an ongoing force / net force

subject: physics
formal_statement: F_net = m·a — acceleration is directly proportional to net force and inversely proportional to mass.

common_misconceptions.description: does not connect push magnitude to acceleration magnitude
inverts the F=ma relationship (multiplies when should divide or vice versa)

subject: physics
formal_statement: For every action there is an equal and opposite reaction: F(A→B) = −F(B→A), acting on two different objects.

common_misconceptions.description: believes the lighter/faster-moving object receives a smaller force
believes only the acting object exerts force, not the receiving object
